start.title: [TODO:ko] The First Light
start.text:
[TODO:ko] Spices in hand, you walk before sunrise.
Who will roll the great stone away?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Turn back. It is too heavy

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Love does not wait at dawn.

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Do Not Turn
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Grief calls you to honor His body.
The path is shorter than the fear.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your feet find the path again.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Go Now
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Some hopes cannot wait for morning.
The spices are in your hands.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You press on toward the tomb.

stone.title: [TODO:ko] The Stone Is Moved
stone.text:
[TODO:ko] The great stone lies rolled aside.
The tomb gapes open in the dawn.

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Do Not Flee Yet
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Truth waits inside the open door.
Go near. See what God has done.

accuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Theft
accuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] No grave robber leaves linen folded.
This is something far greater.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You step softly into the light.

enter.title: [TODO:ko] Linen Cloths Lying
enter.text:
[TODO:ko] The slab is bare. Folded cloths remain.
His body is not here.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Lift your eyes. Heaven is speaking.
[TODO:ko] A light begins to fill the cave.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Touch the folded cloths in anger
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Anger blinds the eye to glory.

weep_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Lift Your Eyes
weep_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Tears are right, but look up now.
You are not alone in this place.

anger_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Anger
anger_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Linen folded with care is no theft.
Look up. See who waits with you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your hands fall open in awe.

angels.title: [TODO:ko] Two Shining Ones
angels.text:
[TODO:ko] Two figures in white ask softly,
"Why seek the living among the dead?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] He is not lost. He is risen.
[TODO:ko] Their words fall like gentle rain.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Be Still and Hear
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Your grief is heard, but listen now.
This is a message you must carry.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You bow your head in reverence.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] He Is Not Held
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] No tomb can keep what God has raised.
Be still and hear the truth.

message.title: [TODO:ko] He Is Risen
message.text:
[TODO:ko] "He is not here. He is risen,
as He told you in Galilee."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His voice rises in your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Boast that you knew all along

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Trust His Word
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] He said on the third day He would rise.
Let His promise meet your heart.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Pride
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] This news is not yours to wear.
It is yours to carry, gently.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You lower your head in awe.

remember.title: [TODO:ko] Run with the News
remember.text:
[TODO:ko] The other women wait, pale with fear.
What will you do with this hope?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Tell them. Go to the disciples
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You take their hands and run.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Speak It Out
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] A locked heart cannot carry light.
Let the joy run from your lips.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Tell them. Go to the disciples

test_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Plain Words
test_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Tell them clearly. The tomb is empty.
He is risen, as He said.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Tell them. Go to the disciples

disciples.title: [TODO:ko] Peter and John
disciples.text:
[TODO:ko] Peter stares. John leans in.
"The Lord is risen," you say.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Peter rises and begins to run.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Beg them to come prove it
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] They already believe enough to run.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Blame, Joy
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Their hiding will turn to running soon.
Give them only the good news.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Steady, Not Begging
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Truth needs no pleading to be true.
Stand and tell them plainly.

sunrise.title: [TODO:ko] The Promise Fulfilled
sunrise.text:
[TODO:ko] The sun crests the hills. Death is undone.
What fills your heart now?

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Hope, not fear, has the last word.
[TODO:ko] You lift your face into the light.

fear_end_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Hope Wins
fear_end_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Death itself has been undone today.
No fear can outlast that light.

pride_end_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Joy for All
pride_end_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] This morning is not a prize won.
It is a gift to share with everyone.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You open your hands to the sky.

ending.title: [TODO:ko] He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
[TODO:ko] The grave is empty. The promise stands.
Death has lost. Hope has won.
